methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The aim of this article is to evaluate the implementation of the suggested methodology according to the described architecture on a real case.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a measurement-and-monitoring-plan methodology and a four-layer data acquisition/storage/analysis/presentation architecture (a framework/system), demonstrated on a preliminary eco-district case; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Energy performance indicators are mentioned only incidentally.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The project used as a case study is the eco-district of Le Perray-en-Yvelines, France.

stage1.notes: Methodology + data-architecture paper on one preliminary eco-district (buildings/micro-grid) case; no EnPI/EnB model. paper_type borderline: single applied case vs tool/software design.
